name: codeguard
description: AI-powered code review and security audit tool

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.install:all: cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd .. && npm install
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.vercel-build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
